entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I'm calling because I need to return something. I just feel awful about it, but I don't know what else to do.
I'm sorry to hear that, but I'm happy to help. Can you tell me which item you're calling about and what the issue is?

It's a helmet I bought a little while ago for my son's birthday. It's just... the color wasn't right. He wanted the black one, not the blue one. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I was really hoping I could get the money back.
I understand. Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to safety. To clarify, is there a technical fault with the helmet, or is it a preference regarding the color?

Oh no, it's a great helmet. It's just a preference. He hasn't even touched it. I promise, the box is still unopened. I just feel so guilty for getting it wrong, and with the holidays coming up, I really need this money back.
I see. I can certainly look into the return eligibility for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Ride Helmet, delivered 84 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Oh, has it been that long? I hope it's not a problem. I've been so stressed I just kept putting it off.

No problem at all. I've confirmed that for this item, our standard return policy is 90 days from the delivery date. Since you're at 84 days, you're well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Really? Oh, thank you! Thank you so much, Isaac. That is such a huge relief. You have no idea what a weight that is off my shoulders.

You're very welcome. I'm glad I could help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
That's perfect. I'll get that sent out this afternoon. You've been wonderful.
Happy to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again, Isaac.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
